selection: Historical RC class corresponds to CodeIgniter token-bucket code; the original imported release is unknown. Stable 4.7.5 is the comparison reference, not a claim about that original import. No CodeIgniter runtime is bundled.
reason: Native CacheInterface/save/Time contracts do not match RC stores, and its two-key get/save algorithm does not provide atomic concurrent grants. RC retains its public class while using one versioned record, confirmed TTL-refresh CAS and exact integer accounting.
scope: Cache-backed limiter, not durable quotas across cache eviction/clear or APP request coroutine support. Cache storage failures and contention exhaustion fail closed. Source/provenance does not substitute for behavior and live-backend tests.
